#22754
INTRO DATE
MAY 21, Z0vS

ORDINANCE
BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:
SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is hereby amended
by changing all the current B1-1, Neighborhood Shopping District symbols and indications as shown on
Map No. 7-L in the area bounded by:
West Diversey Avenue; a line 150.0 feet west of and parallel to North Lamon Avenue; the
public alley next south of and parallel to West Diversey Avenue; and a line 175.0 feet
west of and parallel to North Lamon Avenue
to those of a C1-1, Neighborhood Commercial District.
SECTION 2. This Ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due
publication.

Address: 4915 West Diversey Avenue
